text:
Ava Lin: paging in — got pagerbot alert at 20:02 UTC for elevated p99 embeddings latency in eu-west. customer-facing error rate up ~0.8% for last 6m. quick snapshot: infra shows high KV cache miss rate + worker CPU sat on embeddings pool.

pagerbot: [ALERT] eu-west embeddings-p99 > 2.5s (now 3.1s). 34 unique errors in 6m. pager: @eng-oncall-primary @eng-oncall-secondary

Ava Lin: I'm primary now until 22:00 UTC, Devon you ok as secondary for the next 45m?

Devon Rhee: I'm on. will take secondary. I'm jumping into metrics and traces now.

Jun Park: I can help with quick KV checks and spin a warm node if needed. ETA 6m.

Sophie Kim: FYI customer-impact summary from support: 3 customers reported timeouts when requesting large-batch embeddings. Severity: medium. I'll keep CS looped.

Ava Lin: current mitigations tried so far:
- scaled embeddings pool from 12 -> 16 nodes (partial improvement, still taily)
- flushed local prefix cache on a small subset (no drop in p99)
- temporarily increased request timeout to 12s for retries (limits 429 noise)

Devon Rhee: traces show a couple of heavy queries causing KV thrash — pattern: many 4k token context embedding requests falling back to cold KV path. suspect prefetch/pinning not working for a new model variant rollout.

Jun Park: checking KV control plane logs — saw 503s from kv-proxy on two primaries around 19:56 UTC, then propagation of failed warm cache entries. Patching a healthcheck flapping issue just now.

Ava Lin: immediate playbook items (short list):
1) stabilize capacity: reduce max batch size for embeddings route to 128 to avoid long tail. (I can push a canary config to eu-west now).
2) pin older model variant for customers impacted (rollback routing for embeddings-v2 -> embeddings-v1) via routing service.
3) if p99 still > 2s after 10m, handback to infra for node warm-up / emergency scaling.

Devon Rhee: pushing config change to reduce batch size to 128 on eu-west canary now. command:
```bash
rdwctl routes update --cluster eu-west --route embeddings --max-batch 128 --canary true
```

ops-bot: deploy triggered by Devon Rhee, id=deploy_349876_01, status=STARTED

Ava Lin: also, Jun please run the quick KV health checklist (runbook link below) and paste results here if you can.

Jun Park: running KV runbook checks:
- kv-proxy health: degraded (2/4 unhealthy)
- cache hit ratio last 10m: 11% (baseline 64%)
- steady error 503 spikes correlated with proxy restarts 19:55-20:00
- disk I/O on kv-primary-3 high, investigating IOwait

Jun Park: suspect noisy neighbor on kv-primary-3 — i've flagged process hogs and restarted the local prefetch service. that'll be a brief blip.

Sophie Kim: CS update: notified customers on affected plans (A/B customers) that we're investigating and rolling mitigations; next update expected in 30m.

ops-bot: deploy deploy_349876_01 status=SUCCESS (canary applied to 2/6 nodes)

Devon Rhee: canary metrics: p95 improved from 1.4s -> 0.9s on canary nodes, but global p99 still 2.7s due to remaining cold nodes.

Ava Lin: good. action items for next 20m:
- Devon: continue canary rollout if stable, watch for increased CPU on canary nodes (don't exceed 75% CPU).
- Jun: replace kv-primary-3 or rehome its volumes to avoid IOwait; consider evacuating to standby.
- Sophie: send interim update to customers (short note + ETA).
- Ava: coordinate with infra for emergency scale if p99 stays >2s after 20m.

Devon Rhee: starting gradual rollout to remaining nodes now, will stop if error rate increases or CPU >75%.

Jun Park: evicting problematic pod from kv-primary-3, will drain and force reattach to standby. ETA 8m.

Ava Lin: coverage note: I'm primary until 22:00 UTC. Devon will be secondary until 21:30 then re-evaluate. If either of us needs to step out, call out in thread — watchlist: @Sophie K for customer comms, @Jun P for infra ops.

Sophie Kim: posted customer update: "We're seeing elevated latency for embeddings in eu-west; team is actively mitigating (canary rollout + KV node remediation). Next update in 30m or sooner. Apologies for the disruption." :pray:

Devon Rhee: rollout halfway, no regression so far. monitoring dashboards pinned to thread: https://redwood.app/dashboards/eu-west-embeddings (handy links).

ops-bot: kv-primary-3 volume detach complete, node reattached to standby cluster. health check pending.

Jun Park: health check passed on rehomed node, cache hit ratio trending up to 38% (from 11%).

Ava Lin: status check 20:25 UTC: p99 down to 1.8s, error rate down to 0.2%. still not at baseline but trending stable.

Devon Rhee: will keep watching for 30m. If we stay stable, we'll close incident and run postmortem template. If tail reappears, escalate to infra oncall for horizontal scale.

Ava Lin: handoff summary for next oncall:
- active alerts: eu-west embeddings p99 (mitigating), kv-proxy flaps resolved, kv-primary-3 replaced and healthy.
- current mitigations in progress: canary rollout completed to all nodes, batch size reduced to 128, kv node remediation done.
- customer impact: medium earlier, now minimal for majority; 3 customers reported timeouts earlier (CS notified).
- next steps: monitor p99 for 60m, keep customers informed, prepare postmortem draft if we close.

Sophie Kim: noted — I'll draft postmortem skeleton and ping product & support for input.

Devon Rhee: last check 20:35 UTC p99 = 1.7s, errors ~0.1%. I'm marking secondary until 21:30, remaining on watch.

Ava Lin: thanks all. I am handing off final watch to Devon at 21:00 UTC (I'm stepping off for a meeting). If anything noisy after 21:00, escalate to infra oncall and @eng-oncall-rotation.

Devon Rhee: acknowledged. I'll post a final status note in 30m unless we close earlier. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: incident resolved? no — alerts suppressed automatically due to lower p99. Keep monitoring.

Ava Lin: (private) quick note to next shift: if p99 creeps >2s again, consider temporarily routing heavy customers to other regions and open a support bridge. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-kv-eviction-checklist

Sophie Kim: thanks team — handing to Devon for watch.
